question: World Athletics Under-20 Championship–2021 was held from 18 to 22 August 2021 at _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kenya**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **World Athletics Under-20 Championship–2021** was held from 18 to 22 August 2021 in **Nairobi, Kenya**.
 
• Kenya was chosen as the host country due to its strong history in athletics and its ability to successfully organize international events.
 
• The event featured young athletes from around the world competing in various track and field events.
 
• The championship provided a platform for junior athletes to showcase their talents on a global stage and gain valuable experience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **World Athletics Under-20 Championships** are organized by **World Athletics**, the international governing body for the sport of athletics.
 
• The event is held biennially and features athletes who are 19 years of age or younger.
 
• The championships serve as a stepping stone for young athletes aiming to compete at senior-level international competitions, such as the World Championships and the Olympics.
 
• Kenya has a rich history in middle and long-distance running, producing many world-class athletes who have excelled in global competitions.
 
• Hosting the Under-20 Championships in Nairobi provided an opportunity to inspire and motivate the next generation of Kenyan athletes.
